shown.message:
I approved `paper-repo`#11 (Version 2, `main` into `release`) at head 3f15b47. My earlier `must` finding is resolved.

The appendix paragraph on uploader grouping now has its code and results in the delivery. `results/olb_uploader/` and `code/44_olb_uploader.sh` are there, and `code/README.md` lists the step (row 23). The delivered values match what the paper reports: floor 4.79, gains 2.11, 1.88, 1.35, 0.79, 0.44 and 0.25, over 717 uploader groups. The paper sources are unchanged since the head I reviewed, and the built document is from 3f15b47.

The Version 2 review record, `reviews/v2-release-207ba7e.md`, now has the re-review at the end.
